# Genesis Apocryphon Column 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 10 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 10:2 — "rested" vs "came to rest" vs "settled"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the ark rested" | Literal nuach |
| LOGOS | "the ark came to rest" | Formal with verbal phrase |
| PNEUMA | "the ark settled" | Dynamic synonym |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the ark came to rest." Captures the process implied by the narrative context; also preserves a Noah/nuach echo.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:3 — "from upon the earth" vs "from the face of the earth"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "from upon the earth" | Literal me-'al ar'a |
| LOGOS | "from upon the earth" | Same as EMET |
| PNEUMA | "from the face of the earth" | Dynamic using biblical idiom from elsewhere |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "from upon the earth." PNEUMA imports a phrase ("face of the earth") from a different biblical context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 10:5 — "sent forth" vs "released"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he-sent-forth the dove" | Literal shalach |
| LOGOS | "he sent forth the dove" | Standard formal |
| PNEUMA | "he released the dove" | Dynamic synonym |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "he sent forth the dove." "Sent forth" is the established biblical rendering (Gen 8:8); PNEUMA's "released" loses the purposeful connotation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:7 — "plucked off" vs "freshly plucked" vs "freshly torn"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "plucked-off" | Bare literal |
| LOGOS | "freshly plucked" | Formal with "freshly" |
| PNEUMA | "freshly torn" | Dynamic with "torn" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "freshly plucked." More vivid than EMET; "plucked" is more accurate than PNEUMA's "torn" for an olive leaf.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 4*
*Resolution: LOGOS 3, EMET/LOGOS 1, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
